title: RetroAchievements
description: EmuDeck now uses the RetroAchievements new API and we've added support for Dolphin RetroAchievements setup

title: Resolution selector
description: Change the resolution of more emulators from within EmuDeck, added PPSSPP, Xemu, Vita3K, Azahar and PrimeHack. Fixed a bug where resolutions weren't being applied on installation.

title: Embedded videos
description: Fixed the youtube video error on embedded videos in the app

title: EmuDeck Compressor
description: Fixed an issue where EmuDeck Compresor couldn't be launched from the EmuDeck app

title: EmuDeck Start Menu links
description: The EmuDeck app will restart explorer.exe to reset the Start Menu cache that prevented the EmuDeck icons to be shown

title: Import / Export
description: Export your EmuDeck installation to another device. Steam Deck to Steam Machine, Linux <-> Windows, etc.

title: Import / Export
description: Export your EmuDeck installation to another device. Steam Deck to Steam Machine, Linux <-> Windows, etc.

title: Several Bug fixes
description:
Azahar: sysdata now linked to bios/azahar/keys instead of bios/azahar

Dolphin: Downloads the latest release instead of an old fixed release

Eden: New BIOS/firmware check

ES-DE: picks the right RPCS3 variant per file type (directory or ISO)

Gamelists now live in storage/es-de/gamelists through a link created on install and init. This should improve updating ESDE in the future

Launchers: FullScreen popup should now close after launching an emulator. This pop up is necessary to avoid Steam stealing focus when launching Emulators

RetroArch : New buildbot downloader that fetches the cheats database into storage/retroarch/cheats and the PPSSPP assets into bios/PPSSPP when the folders are empty

Steam ROM Manager: New parser Sony PlayStation 3 - RPCS3 (ISO).

Safer detection of steamDirectory and parsers on fresh installs

PCSX2: Executable renamed before moving into place, which fixes updates.

Primehack: Downloads the latest GitHub release instead of 1.0.7a

RPCS3: config.yml cleaned of obsolete keys

Ryujinx: SDL3 migration. Config bumped to version 73

ShadPS4: sys_modules linked to bios/shadps4/sys_modules
